maximum_depth_rule: All 270 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once with their registered document, PDF location, raw text, tokens, unit, scope, operator, and unresolved comparability boundary.
version_boundary: The fiscal 2026 edition, prior fiscal 2024 and 2025 editions, whole-strategy goals, policy and measure KPIs, annual actuals, estimates, reference values, and individual-plan indicators remain separate versions and layers.
non_goals: Do not infer additional records from the second selected landing-page link or prior strategy editions.
Do not collapse baseline, target, actual, estimate, national value, and reference value into one unreviewed series.
Do not promote mixed multi-year statements or individual-plan indicators into verified annual outcomes.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
